properties.evidence: THE CLASS TEST (step ⑥): does the cause explain the EARLIER occurrence, not just today's? Yes, and from a different fleet and model. That agent used search_design, get_node, create_node, loop_status and get_skill constantly — everything already in its hand — and used detect_gaps, gap_to_prompt, impact-check, detect_defects, reconcile_artifacts, coverage_report and evidence_report exactly zero times. Nothing it was already calling required any of them. Its own reason (3) states the same mechanism independently: 'skills are PULL, and the thing that would tell you to load one is itself a lookup you must remember to make.' Its measured discriminator — three blocking gates each produced an immediate fix, zero passive hints did — is the same shape and was reproduced a third time today.
